purpose: Review sixteen semi-realistic painted 1-star summon identities beside identity-matched chibi combat derivatives.
candidateBoundary: Nothing in this experiment is approved or runtime-ready. A Keep decision means worth developing, not catalog promotion.

batchRules.combatDerivative: roughly 2.75-head chibi preserving identity and costume DNA

knownIssues: The image generator baked a white-and-light-gray checkerboard into the chibi RGB pixels instead of returning an alpha channel.
Chibi transparency cleanup is required only after a hero is selected; these files remain valid composition and identity candidates.
